opti-1: Up close, a honey bee drinks from a flower.
opti-2: Pull back. A whole meadow hums with life.
opti-3: A rabbit hides in the grass.
opti-5: Then, one day, part of the meadow is gone.
opti-6: Where did the flowers go? And the bees?
opti-7: Now the rabbit sits on short grass, out in the open.
opti-8: When people change a place, what happens to the living things there?
22-02-welcome: Our film starts in a meadow. First, look closely at a tiny visitor and what it came for.
22-02-lesson: Today you're the case study scientist. Order the scenes, test for hiding places, walk the edge, then open real Florida cases.
22-02-check: Three quick questions. It's not graded. It's just for you, so give each one your best try.
22-02-assign: Time to show what you found. Explain what the parking lot changed, and whether the flower border really helps.
how-22-02-specimen: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the bee and the flower, then tap three things you notice.
how-22-02-compare: Put the box under one tray and the lamp under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap and test again.
how-22-02-wall: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.
how-22-02-det: Pick three case files, one at a time. Tap a clue, then pick what it lost. Predict which fix works, and watch the place today appear.
how-22-02-partc: Draw the meadow before and after the parking lot. Label what changed, and one living thing that was affected.
